name: Matteo Marconi
bio: I'm a passionate developer who thrives at the intersection of technology and creativity. With expertise spanning full-stack web development, blockchain, and 3D graphics, I build experiences that push the boundaries of what's possible on the web.

My journey into programming started with a curiosity for how things work under the hood. That curiosity has evolved into a career focused on crafting performant, accessible, and visually striking applications.
When I'm not coding, you'll find me exploring the latest in Web3 technology, experimenting with generative art, or contributing to open-source projects.
